description: Participants set and defend reliability standards for AI services that other teams build. For a fictional postal and parcels operator running a bilingual tracking assistant on a self-hosted open-weight model with retrieval, they write service level objectives for availability, latency and answer quality, set admission limits with headroom from measured goodput, design and chaos-test degradation paths, lead incident drills and blameless reviews, release through canaries with automated rollback, and admit models only after verifying signatures and bills of materials.
audience: Specialists. Engineers who have completed the level 300 core or can show equivalent work: a production AI system they built, operated and can defend.
prerequisites: AE-305 Operating Machine Learning and Language Model Systems
AE-307 Container Orchestration and Cloud Infrastructure for AI Workloads
Has written alerting rules on service metrics
Runs containers on a single-node cluster
Has released a service through a canary or blue-green rollout
Reads a goodput-versus-concurrency curve (the measurement method is taught in AE-401)

outcomes.text: Design service level objectives for availability, latency and answer quality, with error budgets and a release policy, given a month of synthetic telemetry and a sampled online quality signal
outcomes.evidence: an objectives document defended against a reviewer's challenges

outcomes.text: Decide an admission limit and shedding priorities that keep headroom for the busiest hour, given the self-hosted model, a recorded traffic trace and the service objectives
outcomes.evidence: a justified operating point and margin, and an overload replay in which priority traffic still meets its objective

outcomes.text: Design degradation for overload and dependency failure using load shedding, a smaller fallback model and a cached-answer mode, given overload, retrieval outage and provider timeout scenarios
outcomes.evidence: chaos test results showing each path keeps the minimum service, with quality measured in each mode

outcomes.text: Lead an incident drill from detection to recovery and write a blameless review, given a silent quality regression after a model update
outcomes.evidence: a timeline, a decision log, owned corrective actions and a new regression test

outcomes.text: Build a release gate that verifies model signatures, a bill of materials and licences before deployment, given signed, tampered and unlicensed model artefacts
outcomes.evidence: a pipeline run that admits the valid artefact and rejects the others, with logs

outcomes.text: Review another team's AI service for production readiness and set launch conditions, given a peer's service, its telemetry and a readiness checklist
outcomes.evidence: ranked findings and a launch decision defended before a panel

The follow-up task applies one reliability standard to a service in the participant's own team or an open-source deployment
